---
name: review-brand-recall
description: Plan and interpret a brand recall and recognition check using captured brand cues.
---

Use DIFF-003. Show the page to intended visitors for a consistent exposure time. After a neutral distraction, ask which brand they remember without hints. Record verbatim answers before showing randomized alternatives for a separate recognition task. Track prior familiarity, sample size, timing and correct answers for each task. Use consented aggregate results. A logo inventory alone leaves recall undecided.
